objective: 5x non-branded organic clicks while increasing qualified employer enquiries
status: Target, not a forecast or achieved result
comparison: Compare equivalent 28-day periods, segment brand queries, inspect seasonality and employer versus candidate intent. Establish baseline before launch.
reviews: After indexing: confirm submitted URLs and chosen canonicals
After 28 days: review query relevance, impressions, clicks, and landing pages
After 56 days: improve pages with relevant impressions but weak engagement or conversion
After 84 days: expand only clusters showing employer intent and useful enquiry outcomes
attribution: Use existing approved analytics and CRM configuration. A booking-screen visit is not a completed booking. This release does not add a tracking provider.
